commands:
set -o pipefail
mkdir -p /fixtures/source
gcloud storage cp '<fixture-store>/aws-public-blockchain/current-eba31d9/part-*.parquet' /fixtures/source/
manifest="$(mktemp)"
files=(/fixtures/source/*.parquet)
[[ -f "${files[0]}" ]] || { echo "no staged parquet files" >&2; exit 1; }
for file in "${files[@]}"; do
  digest="$(sha256sum "$file")"; digest="${digest%% *}"
  size="$(stat -c %s "$file")"
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\n' "${file##*/}" "$size" "$digest"
done | LC_ALL=C sort > "$manifest"
actual="$(sha256sum "$manifest")"; actual="${actual%% *}"
[[ "$actual" == f4a839f23a1be94047491339dfd1ae5dd40d075c5a7c2eac1e07156dd985d4b0 ]] || { echo "fixture digest mismatch: $actual" >&2; exit 1; }
rm -f "$manifest"
